name: 纸艺童趣分体式儿童餐椅款
description: 分体式设计轻巧耐摔、可拆卸餐盘易清洗、一椅多用陪伴成长

styleLock.backgroundSystem: paper-cut storybook diorama backdrops: flat sky-blue #6C9BC2, dusty pink #C98B96 or mauve #A67BA0 walls with layered mint-green #A9D8C4 paper hills, white paper clouds and tree/mushroom cutouts; flat light-grey #F2F0F1 panels for info screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-top key, soft contact shadow, cheerful even tone, no harsh shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless matte paper-craft backdrop with layered paper ground in the same hue family as the wall
styleLock.typography: rounded geometric sans-serif headlines only, deep plum #3D2645 on light panels and #FFFFFF on colored panels; no mixed fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons, single stroke weight, deep plum #3D2645, minimal complexity
styleLock.presentationRules: single stable centered hero object; consistent slight 3/4 hero family angle across variant panels; product clearly the subject; at most one small toy prop; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
noDrift: no realistic photo backgrounds breaking the paper-cut system
styleLock.lockText: {style_lock} consistent playful premium mother-and-baby ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sky-blue #6C9BC2, mint-green #A9D8C4 and dusty pink #C98B96 bases with magenta-purple #B23A9B product accent and deep plum #3D2645 text; warm tone; paper-cut storybook diorama backgrounds with white paper clouds, layered paper hills and tree or mushroom cutouts alternating with flat light-grey #F2F0F1 info panels; bright soft studio lighting with front-top key and soft contact shadows, no harsh light; rounded geometric sans-serif headlines only; thin-line circular outline icons in deep plum; rounded rectangular label bars and dashed rounded callout boxes; stable centered product presentation with a consistent slight 3/4 hero family angle for variant panels; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏一眼锁定产品，童趣纸艺氛围拉高点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front view from a low child-eye-level angle, full product visible, centered
shots.lighting: bright soft front-top studio key with even fill, soft contact shadow
shots.background: paper-cut storybook diorama: sky-blue #6C9BC2 wall, layered mint-green #A9D8C4 paper hills, white paper clouds and tree cutouts
shots.props: one small toy duck accent #F2C94C resting on the tray
shots.textZone: top-center headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF around 40pt with one short sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」 below and one rounded pill label 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF on #B23A9B above
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic hero screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 front view from a low child-eye-level angle, full product visible and centered, filling 60-70% of the frame and grounded by a soft contact shadow. Bright soft front-top studio key with even fill. Paper-cut storybook backdrop: sky-blue #6C9BC2 wall with layered mint-green #A9D8C4 paper hills, white paper clouds and small tree cutouts. One small toy duck accent #F2C94C rests on the tray. Top-center headline in #FFFFFF around 40pt reading 「{callout_1}」, one short sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」 below, and one rounded pill label 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF on #B23A9B above; headline, product and backdrop lock into one complete balanced KV. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no real photo background, no cut-off edges, no floating product without contact shadow, no deformed toy.

shots.intent: 用六枚图标阵列快速传达核心卖点结构，建立产品力认知
shots.camera: flat straight-on infographic layout, no camera perspective
shots.textZone: headline 「{callout_1}」 top center; 3x2 grid of six thin-line circular icons each with a short label using 「{selling_point_1}」 to 「{selling_point_6}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic feature grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat straight-on layout on light grey #F2F0F1: six thin-line circular outline icons in #3D2645 arranged 3x2 with even spacing, even shadowless flat light. The top edge of {product} rises into the bottom of the frame occupying 30-40%. Headline in #3D2645 at 32pt reading 「{callout_1}」 top center; icon labels at 14pt using 「{selling_point_1}」 through 「{selling_point_6}」. Headline, icon grid and product edge lock into one complete balanced panel. Negative: no dense body text, no photorealistic icons, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra decorative elements, no mixed icon styles.

shots.intent: 用三个成长阶段的使用场景建立代入感并覆盖年龄跨度
shots.camera: three-panel vertical grid, each panel an eye-level candid lifestyle frame, identical framing logic across panels
shots.lighting: soft natural window light, consistent direction across all panels
shots.background: dusty pink #C98B96 layout panel holding three lifestyle frames of bright home interiors with plants and sofa
shots.props: home plants and sofa as scene context inside the lifestyle frames
shots.textZone: headline 「{callout_1}」 top center; one rounded label bar per panel reading 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce lifestyle scene grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three-panel vertical layout on dusty pink #C98B96 backdrop: one tall candid frame at top-left and two stacked candid frames at right, each an eye-level lifestyle shot of a toddler using {product} at home in bright soft natural window light with consistent direction. Home plants and sofa as context, product clearly the subject in each frame occupying 40-50% of its panel. Headline in #3D2645 top center reading 「{callout_1}」; one rounded label bar per panel in #B23A9B with white 14pt text reading 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」. Headline, three frames and label bars fill the panel as one balanced grid composition. Negative: no recognizable faces, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no cluttered scene covering the product, no deformed hands, no inconsistent light direction between panels.

shots.intent: 放大安全环保材质细节，消除父母对接触安全的顾虑
shots.camera: macro close-up on the seat shell and rounded edge from a 45-degree raking angle, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft raking side light revealing matte plastic texture, controlled highlight
shots.textZone: headline 「{callout_1}」 top-left in #FFFFFF with two short trust lines 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」; the matte plastic grain and rounded edge stay fully readable
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Macro close-up on the seat shell and rounded edges photographed from a 45-degree raking angle, matte food-contact-grade plastic texture sharp in the foreground, shallow depth of field. Soft raking side light with controlled highlight, gradient sky-blue #6C9BC2 to #4C7BA6 backdrop. Detail occupies 55-60% of the frame. Top-left headline in #FFFFFF reading 「{callout_1}」 with two short trust lines 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」; the visible plastic grain and smoothly rounded edges carry the trust message and no certification documents, seals or serial numbers appear. Negative: no invented certifications, no fake test reports, no dense certificates, no badge shapes, no brand logo, no watermark, no blurry subject, no extra text, no over-smoothed plastic.

shots.lighting: bright soft top light, soft contact shadow
shots.background: dusty rose #C08475 flat wall with matching floor tone
shots.props: one white dashed rounded callout box floating beside the tray
shots.textZone: headline 「{callout_1}」 top-left with sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」; the dashed callout box beside the tray reads 「{callout_2}」 in #3D2645

Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, the detachable tray lifted apart from the seat base to explain the split structure, together filling 65-75% of the frame. One white dashed rounded callout box floating beside the tray reads 「{callout_2}」 in #3D2645. Bright soft top light with soft contact shadow on dusty rose #C08475 flat wall backdrop. Top-left headline in #FFFFFF reading 「{callout_1}」 with sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」; headline, tray structure and callout box lock into one complete balanced composition. Negative: no unrealistic exploded parts, no screws or tools, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no floating product without contact shadow, no warped round edges.

shots.lighting: identical bright soft studio light and soft contact shadow on both panels

shots.props: one small toy duck accent #F2C94C on each tray
shots.textZone: one short label per panel reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant showcase of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two matched vertical panels: top panel on sky-blue #6C9BC2 with white paper clouds showing the blue variant #2E86C8 (hex-pinned), bottom panel on mauve #A67BA0 with white paper clouds showing the pink variant #B23A9B (hex-pinned), both at the identical slight 3/4 hero angle with identical bright soft studio lighting and soft contact shadows. One small toy duck accent #F2C94C on each tray. Variants together occupy 60-70% overall with even balanced margins around both panels. One short label per panel in #3D2645 reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, completing one mirrored two-panel composition. shots.intent: 结构化参数与尺寸标注打消尺寸与适龄疑虑

shots.background: light grey #F2F0F1 flat panel with thin dashed divider lines #7FA0C0
shots.textZone: headline 「{callout_1}」 top center; structured spec rows using 「{selling_point_1}」 to 「{selling_point_4}」 plus one color-dot row
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on infographic spec sheet on light grey #F2F0F1: two units of {product} side by side at the same slight 3/4 angle (blue #2E86C8 and pink #B23A9B, hex-pinned), filling 65-75% of the frame, thin dashed divider lines #7FA0C0, dimension callout lines in #3D2645. provenance.notes: 9 张详情页长图切片提炼；已剥离品牌标识（DW/大卫先生素材字标）、年份徽章、会员二维码贴片、模特面孔与全部原图文案。品类判定：主品为分体式 PP 儿童餐椅（带可拆卸餐盘、一椅多用），判为 母婴/喂养，与源文件夹「母婴」一致；年龄话术与尺寸不复述原图数字，数值由生成时填入。
